integrity: The theorem is proved symbolically from unique factorization and a prime-adic lcm-of-gcds identity. A deterministic finite verifier exhausts 780 exponent tuples as regression evidence; that computation is not used to establish the unbounded statement.
scientific_limitations: The theorem fixes one integer \(n>1\) and positive parameters for the gcd-exponent function. It does not treat the lcm-exponent companion or relations between different base integers. The exact date 2021-04-06 is the earliest exact public full-text date verified for the focal paper; consulted journal metadata identifies the issue only as March 2021.
title: Exact parameter fibers for a gcd-exponent arithmetic function
